resepignev:
Opinions on this?
https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/983604ad9

Firstly I'd like to say that I have nothing against Zicuri nor his team 'Horizon' but he has a history of cheating in the past, especially on servers such as OCN. He was also fairly recently banned by badlion's GCheat, one of the best anti-cheats in the world (https://www.badlion.net/appeal/thread/158886). 

The ban occured 10 months ago.


The first clip I'll show you isn't on Avicus itself, but is a first person 1v1 he uploaded very recently (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4JOJEeGvghs / Watching in 0.25x speed is preferable too). At 1:25, despite having the knockback disadvantage, he is able to hit the player from a good 4 blocks away. Perhaps this is due to his ping but I'd like you to bare this in mind.

Seems fine to me. It just looks like he has better ping.

The first video on Avicus is this wonderfully edited clip https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VI3J_I-9ODw. Again his first hit is around 4 blocks away, and the knockback he gives is insane. Yes yes I'll probably hear the usual "Avicus knockback is messed up" but this is different. The first 2 hits send purchase 2 blocks into the air each, following knockback of about 4 blocks horizontally. Zicuri manages to keep perfect aim and land all 3 possible hits despite this strange and unusual kb that you don't see in a normal fight. Perhaps aimbot but also a chance of reach/an autoclicker being used. This (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RJns9369vpI&feature=youtu.be&t=33s) is the clip from first person POV. 0:33 shows that Seuth isn't able to land the hit, despite having perfect aim and a much better ping advantage (as far as I know Seuth's average is around 10-40 while Zicuri's is between 130 and 300)._

Looks fine to me, if he had aimbot he would have snapped onto the player that attacked him while he was aiming at seuthy

Secondly is this clip, also recorded on Avicus. While the others can be countered fairly easily, to me this is just straight up blatant reach; https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=35ZSJIpYF6k The blocks between the two players are around 4 diagonally but also at a different height. No stupid avicus or minecraft mechanics can explain this.

That's the only thing that looks really sketchy

Lastly is another 1st person POV clip. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RJns9369vpI&feature=youtu.be&t=53s If you slow this down to 0.25x speed again you can see he gets a very unusual first hit despite Seuth once again having perfect aim AND the ping advantage. The vertical kb is also coming into play again here; I'm not too sure what this could be but I only see it happening so frequently to people fighting Zicuri showing it isn't Avicus in general but actually the player himself.

Also looks fine to me, maybe that his head didn't really move is strange.

Walt:
First point: His ban on badlion was almost 8 months ago, ever since then he has played on the account "IronJail" which has NO gcheat bans. 
Badlion, a network with a lot of money does have a semi-decent anti-cheat, but it really only detects blatant hacks, so unless he was using kill aura or something along those lines I believe this to be a false statement. (Seniors can ip check IronJail)

Second Point (1v1 video, not on avicus): Evidence does not matter since its not on avicus, but is useful to help us know what to look for.

Third Point ( sick avicus edit): Personally, looks like he is using some sort of aim assist / reach. But, only the first hit and once he sends purchase in the air are really sketchy. 

Fourth Point/Sixth Point (Seuthy's pov of the last clip): Still looks like he is using some sort of aim assist. Little to none kb and locks on to his head everytime.....

Fifth Point (zicuri v2): Jesus wtf He is cheating.
Nah

Hello, it has come to my attention that one of your STAFF is blatantly cheating.
I would like LFT, Posighdun and Lokigh to NOT be involved in this decision.
I will now compile this conclusive evidence into the thread.

https://youtu.be/-aYT2iltxaE?t=4m47s
Look at his head to start. He is quite clearly headtwitching, although this could be acted out, he headtwitches alot, as you will see in these coming clips.

https://youtu.be/-aYT2iltxaE?t=6m5s  
Look at this clip slowed down. The first hit is clearly out of his reach, it is at least 5 blocks away (since he is jumping) also look at how he catches onto the nearby player. Remember, seuthy was banned for this (https://youtu.be/OsLwME10w1E?t=20s) and Posighdun thought that it was conclusive.

https://youtu.be/35ZSJIpYF6k
This piece of evidence is conclusive on it's own. That is clearly a 5+ block hit, and is not possible at all without cheats. Watch the headtwitch later in the clip also.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RJns9369vpI&feature=youtu.be&t=53s
This, again, another headtwitch. Slow this down and look how perfect he follows seuthy's head. The first hit he gets blatantly outreaches seuthy also, same with the last hit.

https://youtu.be/RV-5cFUBzfU
And to finish off, the most blatant clip of them all. I'll let the clip do the talking.

https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/caea782cf
